blocks.task_summary: Find the second term of a geometric sequence given first term 80 and fourth term 0.74088.
method_path: Set up equation for fourth term: 80 * r^3 = 0.74088

evidence.basis: attempt to find common ratio (M1); 80 r^3 = 0.74088; r = 0.21 (A1); u_2 = 16.8 A1

blocks.task_summary: Given the first two terms of the geometric sequence are the first and eleventh terms of an arithmetic sequence, find the greatest value of the sum S_n of the first n terms of the arithmetic sequence to two decimal places.
method_path: Find common difference d using u_1 = 80 and u_11 = 16.8: 80 + 10d = 16.8 => d = -6.32
Determine n for maximum S_n by finding when u_n > 0: 80 + (n-1)(-6.32) > 0 => n < 13.6582, so n = 13
accepted_alternatives: Use table or graph of S_n to find maximum at n=13, then compute S_13 = 547.04

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: attempt to find common difference (M1); d = -6.32 (A1); attempt to find n using table or graph of S_n (M1); S_13 = 547.04 A1. METHOD 2: attempt to find common difference (M1); d = -6.32 (A1); attempt to find n using u_n > 0 (M1); S_13 = 547.04 A1.
